title: 第3章 捧上铁饭碗第4章 分辨死活
content_zh:
“太太，这是陈观楼送来的礼单，你请过目。”
管家将礼单呈上。
刘万氏拿过礼单一看，轻笑一声，“他倒是舍得。”
区区十两银子的礼物，刘万氏自然看不上眼。但是以陈观楼如今的处境，舍得送出十两银子的礼物，必定是倾尽了全力，可谓是诚意十足。
“太太要帮他吗？”小丫鬟秀娟小心翼翼询问。
刘万氏瞥了眼秀娟，似笑非笑，“怎么着，看上他了。”
秀娟大大方方的承认，“瞧太太说的，那么俊的郎君，谁不喜欢。不过奴婢倒不是看中他的外貌，而是难得陈氏一族还有人愿意上进，不嫌弃天牢乃是贱业。太太莫非是嫌他不识趣？”
刘万氏呵呵两声，面露冷笑，“秀娟，以往可曾有人抵挡本太太的攻伐？”
“不曾有过。那些人个个仿佛色中饿鬼，不堪入目。唯独陈观楼例外。”
“偏偏就是他面对本太太的攻伐，不为所动。此子将来必非池中之物。你说我该不该帮他。”
秀娟顿时谨慎起来。
既不能直接说帮，可是不帮又很违心。她看得出来，陈观楼真的很在意天牢这份差事。
她便斟酌道：“既然收了他的礼，总该让老爷知道此事。”
刘万氏点点头，“有理！收钱办事，是老爷的规矩。只不过十两少了些。此事……”她笑了笑，“还是等老爷回来后再说吧。”
……
傍晚，刘管事忙碌了一天回到家。刘万氏热情的迎了上去，亲手绞了热毛巾给他洗脸擦身，又是揉肩。
等身上舒坦了，一桌精致的席面摆上桌，两口子身子挨着身子，一起吃吃喝喝。
“老爷今儿回来得挺晚。”
“府中那些个嘴碎烂心肠的婆子，整日里偷懒耍滑胡说八道，传到了大哥儿的耳中，大老爷也知道了，发了好大一通脾气。我忙着安抚大老爷，又将那帮碎嘴子婆娘给发卖了，就耽误了时间。”
刘万氏一听，很是意外，“侯府可是积善之家，怎舍得发卖下人。不怕有损名声吗？”

“大老爷动了真怒，谁都劝不动。积善之家，也只是说说而已。”刘管家嗤笑一声，端起酒杯一饮而尽。
刘万氏赶忙斟酒，将酒杯倒满，“今儿我这也有件事。老爷猜猜，今儿谁来了。”
“谁啊？”刘管事不甚在意的问道。
“陈承宗，老爷还记得吗？就是那个在天牢当差，脑子有点愚钝的。”
“他死了好些年吧。”刘管事想起来了。
“他有个儿子，一转眼已经长大了，叫陈观楼。今儿登门，提着风干鸭风干鸡酱肉，还包了一封银子，也算有诚意。说是想进天牢当差，替他父亲的位置。奈何，他父亲的位置早就被人占了。老爷，你说这事要不要帮？”
刘万氏装似随意的说起此事，手里的筷子也没停，一直忙乎着给刘管事夹菜。显得夹菜才是正经事，陈观楼只不过是顺带一提的小事。
刘管事喝着酒，“这个陈观楼如何？”
“陈家里面少有的有上进心的人。不过，他家和侯府早就出了五服，要我说，干脆就不帮。帮了他，老爷又得不到丝毫好处。”刘万氏掷地有声。
content_en:
"Madam, this is the gift list sent by Chen Guanlou. Please take a look at it."
The butler presented the gift list.
Liu Wanshi took the gift sheet, looked at it, and chuckled, "He is willing to give it up."
Naturally, Liu Wanshi looked down upon the gift of a mere ten taels of silver. But given Chen Guanlou's current situation, he must have tried his best to give a gift of ten taels of silver, which can be said to be full of sincerity.
"Do you want to help him, madam?" the little maid Xiujuan asked cautiously.
Liu Wanshi glanced at Xiujuan, half-smiling but not smiling, "What's the matter? I've fallen in love with him."
Xiujuan admitted generously, "Look what my wife said, who wouldn't like such a handsome husband? But this slave is not interested in his appearance, but it's rare that there are people in the Chen family who are willing to make progress and don't despise Tianlao as a lowly career. Could it be that my wife thinks he is ignorant?"
Liu Wanshi chuckled twice, with a sneer on her face, "Xiujuan, has anyone resisted my wife's attack in the past?"
"It's never happened before. All those people are like hungry ghosts, and they are unsightly. The only exception is Chen Guanlou."
"It just so happens that he remains unmoved in the face of my wife's attack. This boy will definitely not be a thing in the pool in the future. Do you think I should help him?"
Xiujuan suddenly became cautious.
I can't directly say to help, but if I don't help, it would be against my will. She could tell that Chen Guanlou really cared about his job in Tianlao.
She then thought about it and said, "Since I accepted his gift, I should let the master know about it."
Liu Wanshi nodded, "That makes sense! It's the master's rule to accept money to do things. It's just that the ten taels are a little less. This matter..." She smiled, "Let's wait until the master comes back."
…
In the evening, Manager Liu returned home after a busy day. Liu Wanshi greeted him enthusiastically, twisted a hot towel with his own hands, washed his face and body, and rubbed his shoulders.
After they felt comfortable, an exquisite table was placed on the table, and the couple sat next to each other, eating and drinking together.
"Master will be back very late today."
"Those gossipy and mean-spirited women in the house were lazy and talking nonsense all day long. This reached the ears of the eldest brother, and the eldest master also knew about it and lost his temper. I was busy appeasing the eldest man, and sold out those gossipy women, which wasted time."
When Mrs. Liu Wan heard this, she was very surprised, "The Hou Mansion is a house that has accumulated good fortune, how can it be willing to betray its servants? Aren't you afraid of damaging your reputation?"
"The eldest master is really angry and no one can dissuade him. A family that has accumulated good deeds is just talk." Butler Liu sneered, picked up the wine glass and drank it all.
Liu Wanshi hurriedly poured wine and filled the glass, "I have something to do today. Guess who is here today."
"Who is it?" Manager Liu asked nonchalantly.
"Chen Chengzong, master, do you still remember? He is the one who works in Tianlao and is a bit dull."
"He must have been dead for many years." Manager Liu remembered.
"He has a son, who has grown up in a blink of an eye, and his name is Chen Guanlou. He came to the door today, carrying dried duck, dried chicken with sauce, and an envelope of money, which is considered sincere. He said he wanted to work as a servant in Tianlao and take his father's position. However, his father's position has long been taken. Master, do you want to help with this matter?"
Mrs. Liu Wan pretended to talk about it casually, without stopping with the chopsticks in her hand, busy picking up food for Manager Liu. It seems that picking up food is a serious matter, and Chen Guanlou just mentioned it in passing.
Manager Liu was drinking, "How about this Chen Guanlou?"
"There are few motivated people in the Chen family. However, his family and the Hou Mansion have already released the fifth service. If you ask me, I just won't help him. If I help him, I won't get any benefits." Liu Wanshi said loudly.
